name: Ananda Chatbot Development
install: PYTHON_BIN=$(command -v python3.11 || command -v python3) && "$PYTHON_BIN" -c 'import sys; assert sys.version_info >= (3, 11), "Python 3.11+ required"' && "$PYTHON_BIN" -m pip install --user --upgrade pip-tools pip-audit && "$PYTHON_BIN" -m venv venv && . venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt && playwright install && touch .env.ananda && (grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc)
